not_reachable: Could not reach the server. Check the URL and your network connection.
timed_out: Connection timed out. The server may be down or the URL may be incorrect.
dns_resolve: Could not resolve the hostname. Double-check the URL for typos.
unauthorized: Invalid credentials. Please verify and try again.
forbidden: Access denied. Your credentials may not have the required permissions.
internal_server_error: The server returned an internal error. Try again in a few minutes.
service_unavailable: The server is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.
keyring: Could not access stored credentials. You may need to reconnect.
oauth_expired: OAuth token has expired. Please re-authorize.
token_empty: Please enter your GitLab personal access token.
credentials_revoked: Credentials expired or revoked. Please reconnect to the cloud orchestrator.
reconnect_exhausted: Could not reach the cloud orchestrator after several attempts. Check the connection and retry. Last error: {cause}
gitlab_auto_connect_failed: GitLab auto-connect failed. You can reconnect manually from the GitLab panel.
gitlab_no_project: No project associated with this agent. Deploy manually first.
gitlab_no_persona: No persona found matching agent "{name}". Deploy manually.
gitlab_version_tag_failed: Deployed {name}, but the version tag could not be created. This version won't appear in history and can't be rolled back to. Try deploying again.
oauth_timed_out_error: OAuth authorization timed out. Please try again.
oauth_timed_out_toast: OAuth authorization timed out. Please retry.
